haystack.title: Research consultant
haystack.intro: Clients come with a question. My job is to get them a usable answer, from the first meeting to the final presentation. The method follows from the question.

steps.name: Methodology
steps.what: pick the design that answers it

steps.name: Screener & questionnaire
steps.what: the right people, the right questions

steps.name: Fieldwork
steps.what: follow up until the sample is in

steps.name: Insights
steps.what: what the client should decide, and why

haystack.panelTitle: Keeping an eye on what comes next
haystack.panelText: In this team I keep up with the latest innovations in market research and watch where the field is heading: synthetic data, sample boosts, virtual audiences, predictive modelling. We also look for ways to make our internal processes more efficient. In my own work I use automatic dashboards in R and Displayr, and AI tools.
panelTags: On our radar: synthetic data & boosts

jobs.title: CX data analyst
